text: Morning! I'm sketching the online bakery order flow so the dev team can see it. Order comes first, then Bake, then Pack, and finally Ship. Connect them in that order please. If a customer cancels, the order goes to Refund, but that's a rare case. Make Refund red so it stands out. Put Ship at the far right. Hmm, can you make Pack a square? Is there a path from Order to Ship? Move Refund below Bake. What is the most connected shape? Which shapes are linked to Pack? Rename Bake to Oven, the bakers call it that. Show me how many arrows we have. Thanks!
Trailhead is at the bottom. Connect Trailhead to Camp and Camp to Summit. Make the Summit gold. Is Lake bigger than Camp? Thanks!
Put Quit under Options. Make Play green and Options gray. Which shape is the leftmost one?

Router should sit above Modem. Make the Router blue. Hmm, actually make the Router navy because it is the main box. Connect Router to Modem with a dotted line. Which shape is the leftmost? Can you count how many arrows we have now? Rename Switch to CoreSwitch because that's the name in the inventory. Thanks, I'll print this.
Put the weekdays in a row, Mon first. Make Wed teal, I'm off that day. Is Fri the rightmost? Count how many days are shaded. Hmm no, just count the shapes.

Move Winger to the left of Striker. Connect Midfield to Striker, then to Winger. Is Midfield near Striker?

Make Circle1 tiny.
Where is Printer? Move it near Coffee. Then describe Desk for me.
Connect Central to Victoria, Piccadilly and Jubilee in one go. Make Central huge. What's the shortest path from Victoria to Jubilee?

Okay so the input goes to the process, I'm making a basic flowchart for a class. Connect Input to Process and Process to Output. Make Process a blue rectangle. What can be reached from Input? Add a diamond named Error below Process. Make it red. Connect Process to Error with a dashed line. Log sits to the right of Output, put it there. Is Error bigger than Log? Move Log a bit up, around 20 pixels. Which shape has the fewest connections? Also, can you describe the whole diagram for my notes? Thanks, the class is tomorrow.
Duplicate Star1 3 times. Also rename Star2 to Moon.
Lay the chores out in a circle. Dishes is the first one. Is Trash connected to anything? Put Vacuum at the top.

I'm drawing how our repo modules link together so new people can find their way. Connect App to Core and Utils. Connect Tests to App. Docs should be a dashed box below Tests. Hmm, boxes can't be dashed, make it a gray box. Move Docs below Tests. Is there a cycle in this graph? How many arrows touch App? Which shape is the most connected? Also check whether Utils is directly linked to Tests. Make Core huge, it's the foundation. Rename Utils to Helpers, that's the name in the readme. Thanks, I'll paste the picture into the wiki.
Make Surgery red. Triage goes into Surgery and Waiting. Discharge is the last step, put it at the bottom right. Which shape is the most connected?
Arrange Intro, Topic1, Topic2 and Wrap in a column. Connect them one after the other. Undo the arrangement, the column looks wrong.
Is the Door bigger than the Till? Make the Till medium. Delete the Shelf.

Kids game idea: a phone chain where each person whispers to the next one. I'm drawing it on the canvas to explain it to my class. Connect Ring, Ann, Ben and Cy, each one to the next. Dee should be the last person, put her at the bottom right. Is Ann linked to Cy? Make Ring green so the kids know where it starts. Make Dee red because she is the end. Which shape is the farthest from Ring? Duplicate Ben once, we need an extra player. Hmm, I can't move a copy, just skip that. Ask me about the chain later. Thanks, you are a great help to a teacher.
Align Row1, Row2 and Row3 horizontally. Show a list of all the rectangles.

I'm planning a small sculpture garden for the town fair, and I'll test the layout here. Put the Fountain in the center, it's the centerpiece. Bench should be near the Fountain. Move Tree to the left of Bench. Make the Statue huge, people should see it from the gate. Gate goes at the bottom center. Is Tree left of Bench? Which shape is the biggest one? Connect Gate to Statue with a dotted path. Hmm, I'll rethink the path later. Rename Bench to Seat, the council calls it that. How many things are in the garden now? Undo the last move if the tree looks wrong. Thanks!
Pro is blue and Team is purple. Connect Free to Pro, Pro to Team and Team to Enterprise. Which one is the leftmost? Move Enterprise to the top right.
Make the Arm longer. Hmm, enlarge the Arm, I mean. Connect Base to Arm and Arm to Hand. Is Hand below Arm?

Swap A1 and C3 places on the map. Make B2 small. Delete all the stars.
Q1 leads to Q2 if yes. Connect Q1 to Q2 and Q2 to Q3. Q3 goes to Result. Rename Result to Score. How many shapes do we have? Thanks.
Move Spot to the right, 25 pixels.

I'm sketching a city block for a geography homework, and my teacher wants the map to look neat. Put the Museum at the top left. Is the Park the biggest shape? Which shape is closest to the Cafe? Hmm, I think it's the Bank. Make the Bank gold so it stands out. Connect Park to School and School to Museum. Move Cafe a bit to the right, around 30 pixels. Are Cafe and Bank linked to each other? Make X1 navy. Make X2 teal.

Hi, I'm documenting our network layout for a security review next week, so precision matters. Put Igw above Vpc, it's the entry point. Subnet1 and Subnet2 are the private subnets, so connect them to Nat. Nat should connect to Igw too. Is Lb linked to anything? Make Lb a red hexagon, it's the public entry point. Move Subnet2 to the right of Subnet1. Oops, I want the subnets in a column instead, so arrange them in a column. Which shape has the least connections? Duplicate Nat once so we have a backup. Rename Igw to Gateway. Connect Lb to Gateway with a dashed line. How many connections do we have in total? Thanks, this is very helpful.
Make Locked red. Unlocked is green. Connect Locked to Unlocked with an arrow both ways.
Put Ann, Bob, Cara and Dan in a circle. Is Bob next to Ann?
Stack the Payload above the Booster. Engine must be below the Booster. Is Payload above Booster? Yes? Good, thanks.
